items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-10-21
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Oh, I thought maybe he was an arranger like Dumaine. No, he wasn't. He knew it. a whole lot, you know.

ctx.x: He was good. He's dead and gone, but he's missing. Did they have anybody else could arrange hymns like that? Well, I would say, no, no, he's as good as them. Some of them arranged, but they didn't, they couldn't get to the weed, you see? They had to, I want to recall, he must wait. He was good, but he didn't stay alone. He left me with me.

Yeah. I think he's in California now. Yeah. Bill Russell's on it. Yeah. He's around San Francisco. He still plays with the brass band. Yeah, he's an all-round man. Yeah. He is. Well, what did he arrange? Or what did he arrange? Well, he didn't, he didn't, he didn't, he didn't arrange anything.
Oh, I thought maybe he was an arranger like Dumaine. No, he wasn't. He knew it. a whole lot, you know.
